headline: Iranian authorities flog singer Parastoo Ahmadi and four team members with 74 lashes each
label: NEWS
caption:
An Iranian singer and four members of her team were given 74 lashes each after performing without a hijab. 🎤

According to lawyers speaking to the BBC, singer Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were flogged in the city of Qom. Ahmadi had worn a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert in December 2024.

A criminal court in Qom convicted the group of offending public decency through the publication of obscene and indecent material, which the defendants had denied. An appeals court confirmed the sentence at the end of September according to her lawyers.

The defendants were also banned from audiovisual activities and from leaving the country for two years. Human rights activists and other Iranian artists strongly condemned the sentences and warned that flogging constitutes cruel and degrading punishment.
